name: PhD Program in Biology
detailsNote: Official requirements and Fall 2027 dates are available; an admission model was not established from the accessible pages.

english.note: Standardized tests, including TOEFL, are not required or considered in admission.

applicationFee.note: Application is free; no waiver needed.

documents: Detailed research summary and additional research experience
Publications, if any, with contribution descriptions
Official or unofficial transcripts from every postsecondary institution
requirements.note: Bachelor degree or equivalent required. Prior research is central to selection. At least one recommendation should come from a scientist who supervised the applicant’s research. Publications are not required.

funding.note: No tuition; support guaranteed throughout the program in good standing. Required medical/pharmacy/dental plans have shared premiums; vision coverage can be purchased.

timeline.interviews: March 4–5, 2027; selected applicants first give a virtual scientific presentation. Virtual interviews can be arranged when in-person attendance is not possible.
timeline.decisions: Acceptance notices in March; final wait-list status by April 15 (annual FAQ timing).
